reason_zh: 博士论文确认 25 粒子与一组 50 kHz 采样。同期电感电流、输出电压和闭环 PI、采样调理与时延仍缺。
scope_zh: 补齐台架同步波形与实际闭环实现后，执行五参数恢复和采样率敏感性核验。
critical_gaps: No located synchronized vin, iL and vo records across the original load transition.
No verified numeric closed-loop Kp/Ki, analog measurement gains/RC or exact PWM update delay.
The thesis supplies 25 PSO particles but the tested inertia, bounds, stopping threshold and initial states are unresolved.
